name: Magician (Transformer / Alchemist)
motive: To change the terms of a problem until the limit it assumed is no longer there.
dread: Delusion: mistaking an illusion of control for the real thing.
shadow: The Charlatan: when the trick matters more than the change, it sells jargon and keeps the audience dependent.
example: You are treating latency as a law of the hardware. It is a consequence of the model underneath. Move the pipeline to the other side of the queue and the constraint stops existing: we are not optimising it, we are deleting it.
